## Highlights

GlancePane 0.4.1 is a reliability-focused release that makes weather updates,
settings changes, display recovery, and system monitoring more predictable.

## Fixes and improvements

- Weather refreshes now recover correctly after the Weather page is hidden and
  shown again, while obsolete requests can no longer replace newer results.
- Cached weather is tied to the configured provider and location. Complete
  network failures preserve the cache timestamp, and valid no-precipitation
  responses clear stale rain data.
- Settings are applied differentially, so appearance-only changes no longer
  reconnect feeds or reset burn-in protection state.
- Secondary-display startup retries survive an unavailable display and stop
  after a successful recovery. Hidden dashboards no longer process pointer
  gestures.
- CPU, GPU, memory, storage, network, power, thermal, and process sampling now
  runs serially outside the main actor, keeping the interface responsive during
  slow platform calls.
- Rendering coverage now exercises the production dashboard composition across
  all six pages, including scaling, pixel shifts, dimming, and the rest overlay.

## Validation

The release is covered by 91 offline tests, the public-tree privacy audit,
Gitleaks, and arm64 DMG packaging verification.

## Installation

Download `GlancePane-arm64.dmg`, drag GlancePane to Applications, then
Control-click and choose **Open** on first launch if macOS blocks the app. The
release is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/danbao/GlancePane/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1
